setting: a cozy kid bedroom, the same room as in the attached room picture if one is attached: soft warm peach walls, wooden floor, a low wooden bed with a rounded headboard along the back wall on the left, seen from its long side, with a white pillow at the headboard and a smooth lavender blanket; a little wooden shelf with a lamp on the back wall; a window in the middle of the back wall; a round cream rug on the floor in front of the bed. Props look the same in every picture: the bedside table is a small round light-wood table on three short straight legs, a little taller than it is wide, with an empty top; the breakfast table is a small low round wooden table with a plate of bread and a glass of milk; the crayons are red, blue, yellow and green; the crayon cup is small and light blue. Few props, soft warm light, gentle shadows. The bottom-right corner of the picture is plain wooden floor with nothing important in it

pictures.cover: {hero} and Lulu sit on the soft rug, one on each side of the small round wooden bedside table, both smiling up at a round friendly alarm clock with two little bells on its top standing on the table; the clock face is plain cream with only two simple hands and no numbers; the window behind shows warm morning sun on its left half and a dark night sky with a crescent moon on its right half
pictures.sticker: a round friendly cream alarm clock with two little bells on top and small feet, fast asleep: eyes closed in two soft curves, a tiny peaceful smile, rosy cheeks; plain cream face with only two simple hands and no numbers; a tiny glowing yellow crescent moon resting on one bell

day.attach: kit/room_night.png (the night room, copied from tidy_toys)
day.prompt: Edit the attached picture. Keep exactly the same room, camera angle, framing, walls, bed, pillow, blanket, shelf and lamp, window frame, round cream rug, wooden floor, door, colors and soft 3D art style. Change only the time of day to a sunny morning: the window shows a soft light-blue morning sky with a few small white clouds, no moon and no stars; warm golden morning sunlight comes in through the window and falls in a soft bright patch across the floor and the rug; the lamp on the shelf is switched off, with no glow around it; the whole room is brighter and fresher. Remove the small sparkles on the wall above the bed. Add nothing: no people, no animals, no toys, no clock, no text. Keep the same wide picture shape and size as the attached picture: do not crop, extend or reframe it; the bed, pillow, shelf, window, rug, door and floor boards stay at exactly the same places.
